title: Industrial Pump — Interactive Demo
summary: A real-time 3D demonstration of an industrial pump, with interactive inspection and an exploded assembly view.
role: Real-time visualization and interactive prototype development
details: An independently developed browser-based technical demonstration exploring how a complex piece of equipment can be explained through interaction rather than passive imagery. It is a demonstration of visualization and interaction design, not evidence of a client deployment.
challenge: Static renders can show what a machine looks like, but they leave its internal arrangement and operation difficult to inspect.
approach: Build a lightweight, navigable 3D experience that brings assembly, component relationships and motion into the same view.
highlights: Interactive inspection of the pump assembly
Exploded assembly view for examining components
